hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git (commit|push)' && [ "$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null)" = main ]; then echo 'Blocked: on main. Branch first (repo convention: never commit/push to main).' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if [ "${f##*.}" = go ] && [ -f "$f" ]; then gofmt -w "$f" && echo "gofmt: formatted $f" >&2; fi; exit 0
